name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
summary: Mekgineer Thermaplugg is the self-proclaimed ruler of ruined Gnomeregan and the greatest traitor in gnomish history. Once the trusted chief advisor of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, he orchestrated the catastrophic irradiation of the underground city in a twisted bid to seize power. Now thoroughly deranged and transformed into a leper gnome, he commands the irradiated halls from within a massive mechanical battle suit.

sections.title: A Toxic Ambition
sections.body: Mekgineer Thermaplugg served for many years as chief advisor to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who trusted him completely. All the while, Thermaplugg secretly coveted the office of High Tinker. What finally drove him to betray that trust, whether power or wealth, not even Mekkatorque can say; the High Tinker can only note that Thermaplugg would have had both in time.

sections.title: The Poisoning of Gnomeregan
sections.body: When subterranean troggs swarmed Gnomeregan during the Third War, the gnomes fought them in the subterranean darkness. Seeking a way to break the siege, Gelbin turned to Thermaplugg for counsel. Thermaplugg urged him to flood the city with radioactive gas, promising it would destroy the troggs while sparing the gnomes. In truth, Thermaplugg was using the crisis as his chance to unseat Mekkatorque and seize power for himself.

sections.title: King of the Ruins
sections.body: Thermaplugg's gamble proved catastrophically wrong. The radioactive fallout swept uncontrollably through all levels of the city, slaughtering eighty percent of the gnomish population and twisting many of the survivors into feral, diseased leper gnomes. Instead of ascending the throne of a thriving metropolis, Thermaplugg himself was warped by the fallout. Driven utterly mad by the radiation, he crowned himself King of the Gnomes and now presides over a charnel house of irradiated machines and mutated thralls, fighting a perpetual war against trogg invaders and any surface gnomes seeking to reclaim their lost home.

aliases: who is the boss in gnomeregan
faq.answer: He is the former chief advisor to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque who betrayed his people during the trogg invasion. Intending to usurp power, he convinced Mekkatorque to release radioactive gas into Gnomeregan, which resulted in the near-extinction of their race and left him ruling the irradiated ruins as a mad king.

faq.q: Why did Thermaplugg betray Gelbin Mekkatorque?
faq.answer: Even Mekkatorque cannot say for certain. The High Tinker trusted him and wonders whether it was for power or wealth, things Thermaplugg would have had in time anyway. What is known is that Thermaplugg had long secretly coveted the office of High Tinker, and he used the trogg crisis to seize Gnomeregan for himself.

faq.q: Did Thermaplugg cause the trogg invasion?
faq.answer: The troggs originally broke through into Gnomeregan's lower levels after being unearthed from the ancient titan vault of Uldaman. While rumors swirl that Thermaplugg had prior knowledge of the subterranean breach or even facilitated it to engineer a crisis, Mekkatorque has never been able to verify whether Thermaplugg initiated the invasion or simply exploited it.

faq.q: What happened to Thermaplugg after the gas was released?
aliases: how did he become a leper gnome
faq.answer: Like thousands of other gnomes caught in the disaster, Thermaplugg was exposed to lethal levels of radiation. The fallout withered his flesh, turned his skin a sickly green, and fractured his mind. Instead of fleeing with the surviving refugees to Ironforge, he stayed behind to rule the ruins as the self-proclaimed King of the Gnomes.
The Crowd Pummeler 9-60 is a hulking gnomish war machine that still stomps through Gnomeregan's Engineering Labs, one of the many mechanical guardians defending Thermaplugg's irradiated domain.

faq.q: What does High Tinker Mekkatorque want done with Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: Mekkatorque considers Thermaplugg his greatest failure and his people's greatest traitor. From his temporary court in Ironforge's Tinker Town, Mekkatorque actively commissions brave Alliance adventurers to delve into the irradiated depths of Gnomeregan and execute Thermaplugg to bring justice to the fallen.

angles.text: Thermaplugg is the embodiment of everything your people mourn and despise; his vanity and treachery cost you your homeland and turned your kin into diseased horrors.
Thermaplugg's betrayal kept Gnomeregan from answering the call to arms in the Third War, crippling Alliance supply lines and engineering support during humanity's darkest hour.
Thermaplugg represents the lethal hazard of sloppy formulas and unprincipled design, wielding hazardous walking war machines and toxic bomb Dispensers against anyone who enters his workshop.
Your kin in Ironforge gave refuge to the ragged survivors fleeing Thermaplugg's poison, and Ironforge guards watch the Dun Morogh gates closely against his irradiated wanderers.
